explanation.text: The Logic: Per SEBI (AIF) (Second Amendment) Regulations, 2024 w.e.f. April 25, 2024, no AIF may launch any new Liquidation Schemes. The Trap: Dissolution Period replaced this route; new Liquidation Schemes are disallowed. Cross-Exam Context: Same restriction extends to Cat I/II (XIX-A). Distributor's Pro-Tip: Existing Liquidation Schemes can continue under their own terms; only NEW launches are barred.
